title.en: Active Mobility (Prescribed Offences for Section 59A Presumption) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Active Mobility (Prescribed Offences for Section 59A Presumption) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 16 September 2019.

heading.en: Prescribed offences for section 59A of Act

text.en:
2. For the purposes of section 59A of the Act, the following are prescribed offences:
(a)an offence under section 15(4), 16(4), 18(3), 20A(3) or 21(3) of the Act;
[S 52/2020 wef 18/01/2020]
(b)an offence under regulation 14 of the Active Mobility Regulations 2018 (G.N. No. S 251/2018) for contravening regulation 9(1) or (2), 12 or 13 of those Regulations.
